conventions: upstream input/output values retain their original JSON conventions; other byte strings are 0x-prefixed lowercase hex; field elements are 0x-prefixed hex integers; G1 points are {compressed (ZCash 48 B), eip2537 (128 B)} and G2 points {compressed (ZCash 96 B), evm192 (x.c0‖x.c1‖y.c0‖y.c1, 48 B limbs), eip2537 (256 B)}

ethereum_bls12_381_tests.conventions: input and output are unchanged upstream JSON values; label is the upstream filename stem. Generic deserialization accepts canonical infinity; SCCP validate rejects identity keys and signatures. BatchVerify is reproduced by individual verification, not unweighted signature aggregation. EVM affine outcomes describe the translated ABI, which does not carry compressed flags; wrong compressed lengths have no translation (null). TON outcomes describe opcode fixed-prefix reads (-9 for short slices), independently of SCCP's exact-size admission. The hash_to_G2 group uses RFC 9380 QUUX DST and UTF-8 text, unlike the POP signature groups.

ethereum_mainnet_sync_committee.source: fixtures/sccp/rpc/eth/finality_update.json (sync_aggregate, attested_header.beacon) with the period-1868 committee from fixtures/sccp/rpc/eth/updates.json[0].next_sync_committee; Fulu fork version, mainnet genesis validators root, DOMAIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE

generator: scripts/sccp_reference/generate.py (independent Python reference) writes this file alone; iroha_crypto::bls::consensus reproduces every row (crates/iroha_crypto/src/signature/bls/consensus/tests/python_reference.rs)

imported_rfc9380.source: RFC 9380 Appendix K.1 (expand_message_xmd SHA-256) and Appendix J.10.1 (BLS12381G2_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_)

rust_only_vectors: the vectors that need the w3f transcript of iroha_crypto (pinned w3f proofs of possession, a w3f-transcript signature over a consensus digest, a DST_SIG signature presented to the generic API and a proof of possession used as a signature) are not rows of this file. They live in fixtures/sccp/bls_consensus_rust_v1.json (schema iroha.bls_consensus.rust.v1), generated and drift-checked by iroha_crypto. The Python reference checks in pytests/scripts/test_sccp_reference.py every row of that file it can decide without the w3f transcript: the standard sign, verify and aggregate vectors, the allowlist rows and rejections, and the key and consensus-API negatives; the proofs of possession and the verdict of the generic-API negative stay Rust-only

sccp_extra_malformed_inputs.conventions: deserialize includes the subgroup check and accepts canonical infinity; validate additionally rejects infinity. verify checks the recorded key, 32-byte message and signature. EVM affine pairing ignores compressed metadata and has no representation for wrong compressed lengths (null); infinity is a valid affine point. TON opcode returns -9 for short slices and reads only the first 48/96 bytes of long slices; SCCP admission enforces exact sizes before that opcode.
sccp_extra_malformed_inputs.source: SCCP-specific cases beyond ethereum/bls12-381-tests v0.1.2: negated valid points, empty/all-zero/all-one encodings and a valid signature or key with a trailing byte. The upstream long encodings have invalid prefixes; these additional valid-prefix cases distinguish TON opcode prefix consumption from SCCP exact-length admission.
